rejected_preflight.retry_scope: An explicit source correction preceded the only mathematical extension; no accepted or newly computed determinant was replayed.

calculation.scope: One actual mathematical extension after one rejected preflight. Timing is one observation, not a benchmark.

language.witness_scope: A known occurrence inherited from a recorded adjacent-pair witness; not necessarily the earliest.
language.completeness_basis: Retained complete pair closure and its occurrence proof, followed by the block coverage argument.

determinant_reference_rules.left_center_right: Row indices in order n-1, at factor offsets 0,1,2.
determinant_reference_rules.inner: Row index in order n-2 at offset 2; -1 denotes empty determinant 1 at n=2.
determinant_reference_rules.order_one: All four minor columns are null.

source_row_reuse.rule: Same order and row index; determinant and four minor columns preserved. Carrier witness index remapped.

extension.assembly: All listed blocks are required; archive.index alone is not the complete index.
